title: Tenma Saki — For Our Next Show!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Morning♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, hold on! There's really nobody here!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It is pretty early.
The ones having morning practice are probably all with their respective clubs right now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. That means we can talk about our song all we want until homeroom!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. I'd like to keep discussing that part we talked about on the phone yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, about fixing up the chorus?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I recorded a few samples and was wondering how they sounded. Can you give them a listen with me?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure, let's!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Phew...!
This is going pretty smoothly, huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, it is. All that's left is to hear what the others think.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me! I got an idea for another song while I was making adjustments and stuff♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. That was fast.
Another song already?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You could say that a little nicer♪
Anyway, here! Listen!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh...
That's a long fade-in.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right? I found a bunch of songs that start like that and really liked them all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So I wanna try doing something like this too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sure, why not?
It seems like a nice way to build up some anticipation for what's coming next.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! I'm definitely saving this idea for later, so maybe someday!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, also!
Hehe♪ I have this other great idea...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Another one...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Remember my notebook titled, “100 Things I Want To Do”...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Of course. The one you made while you were in the hospital.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It has all the things you want to do when you started coming back to school, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Correct!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was thinking that it'd be nice to have something like that for all the songs we're gonna make, you know?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that could be helpful...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: See?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm gonna go grab a notebook from the school store later. Let's go pick one out together♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure, I'll go!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You haven't been able to do many things from that list because of how busy we've been with band stuff, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I know...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But that doesn't bother me right now. There are a lot of things that I want to do, but I can do them one at a time while we focus on our band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: On the flip side, I get to play music with all of you every single day!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's way more important to me♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Writing songs and practicing like this isn't easy...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I get super duper excited whenever we all play something that I came up with♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And you're the one writing lyrics for my music and singing our songs, Ichi! I still can't believe it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I never thought being in a band could be so much fun, so I wanna keep putting that first!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: By the way, I've been making some changes to the “100 Things I Want To Do”♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, did you add more?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
I'll tell you when I feel the time is right.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Aww, not even a little hint?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nope. It's a secret until then♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, but the notebook we're gonna go get later is for everyone to see!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If that's the case, why don't we leave it in SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's somewhere we all go to often, and we can talk about what we write in it whenever we're visiting, no?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! That's a great idea♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, let's do that!
Hehe. I can't wait to get started.
